title: Not every disagreement is rebellion.
paragraphs:
Not every disagreement is rebellion.
Not every separation is division.
Paul the Apostle and Barnabas had a sharp disagreement (Acts 15:39).

And both kept preaching.
Both kept planting churches.
Both kept serving Jesus.

Unity is precious.
But unity is not silence.
And conviction is not hatred.

Sometimes peace protects people.
Sometimes precision protects the gospel.

🔥 One guarded grace.
🌊 One guarded standards.
Both guarded the mission.

The question is:
Did the mission continue?

Before we label someone “divisive”…
Ask:
Am I protecting comfort?
Or protecting truth?
